event_chain.summary: Former governor's account used to download board files

summary: Between February and April 2026 someone used the email account of a former board governor at Quest University in Squamish, British Columbia to get into the university's SharePoint board portal from multiple devices and browsers in Ontario and British Columbia, viewing and downloading 148 confidential legal, financial and real estate files. The documents were then circulated to board members and elected officials. Unable to identify who was responsible, the university sought a court order requiring Bell Canada to disclose IP address information.
